about: Design values of docs/DESIGN.md and docs/PREREG.md draft v0. Chosen values, not results. scripts/design_budget.py reads this file and docs/design/vgdl_scan.json and prints the session arithmetic and the budget (logs/design_budget.log).

development.source_of_count: docs/oracle/READING.md, Section 2 (161 MiniGrid/BabyAI games), from logs/oracle_v2.log; seeds 1000-1009 as in study 1
development.note: one unit per (game, seed): each seed of a MiniGrid game is a different layout; games whose sprites move at random (Dynamic-Obstacles) are excluded when the manifest is written, so the unit count here is an upper bound
